name: High Intensity Interval Training
details: Maintain HR between 150-170 bpm. 5 min warmup, 30 min intervals, 10 min cooldown.
adjustments_if_skipped: Add 15 mins to next low-intensity cardio session.

name: Long Distance Run
adjustments_if_skipped: Do a 45 min run next day instead.

name: Brisk Walking
details: Keep a steady, brisk pace. Good for active recovery.

name: Yoga Session
details: Vinyasa flow focusing on flexibility and breathwork.
adjustments_if_skipped: Do a 15 min stretch before bed.

name: High-protein Breakfast
details: Minimum 30g protein. E.g., Eggs, Greek yogurt, or protein shake.
adjustments_if_skipped: Ensure lunch is very high protein.

name: Balanced Lunch
details: Complex carbs, lean protein, healthy fats.

name: Nutrient-dense Dinner
details: Focus on micronutrients, dark greens, lean protein.
adjustments_if_skipped: Drink a greens supplement next morning.

name: Vitamin D Supplement
adjustments_if_skipped: Take next day, do not double dose.

name: Infrared Sauna
details: Temp 140F. Hydrate well before and after.
